edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the owner during construction, granting privileged rights to the deployer.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before newOwner can be changed.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before the ownership handover completes.
owner state variable is read in the onlyOwner check of transferOwnership.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner check on owner.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the caller check and clears it afterwards.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-controlled address.
transfer computes the sender balance via safeSub.
transfer computes the receiver balance via safeAdd.
safeSub result is written back into the balances mapping by transfer.
safeAdd result is written back into the balances mapping by transfer.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] with the caller as key.
approve overwrites the allowance mapping without a zero-first check.
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender], so the caller controls which allowance is spent.
transferFrom decrements balances and allowance through safeSub.
transferFrom credits the destination balance through safeAdd.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping entry of the spender.
transferFrom updates both balance entries of the balances mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
approveAndCall sets the allowance before performing the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external contract call to receiveApproval while state is already updated.
The untrusted spender contract's receiveApproval callback executes arbitrary code during approveAndCall and can re-enter the token.
Constructor initializes _totalSupply to 5000000.
Constructor assigns the entire supply to the fixed deployer address in balances.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
balanceOf returns an entry from the balances mapping.
allowance returns an entry from the allowed mapping.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards an arbitrary ERC20 transfer call from the token contract to owner.
safeAdd operand a feeds the guarded addition.
safeAdd operand b feeds the guarded addition.
safeAdd performs the unsigned addition a + b guarded by require(c >= a).
safeSub operand a feeds the guarded subtraction.
safeSub operand b feeds the guarded subtraction.
safeSub performs the unsigned subtraction a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
safeMul operand a feeds the guarded multiplication.
safeMul operand b feeds the guarded multiplication.
safeMul performs the unsigned multiplication a * b guarded by a division check.
safeDiv operand a feeds the guarded division.
safeDiv operand b is checked against zero before division.
safeDiv performs the unsigned division a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
safeAdd stores the arithmetic result in the local c that is returned.
safeSub stores the arithmetic result in the local c that is returned.
safeMul stores the arithmetic result in the local c that is returned.
safeDiv stores the arithmetic result in the local c that is returned.
balanceOf returns the local balance read from the mapping.
allowance returns the local remaining read from the mapping.
The _newOwner parameter is stored as newOwner, deferring the ownership transfer.
tokenOwner parameter selects the balance mapping key returned by balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter selects the outer key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter selects the inner key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
to parameter is credited in balances by transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount manipulated by the SafeMath arithmetic in transfer.
spender parameter becomes the inner allowance key in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
from parameter is the debited account and allowance key in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount manipulated by the SafeMath arithmetic in transferFrom.
spender parameter is both the allowance key and the untrusted call target in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is written to allowed and passed to the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary data bytes are forwarded into the external receiveApproval callback call.
tokenAddress parameter is invoked through ERC20Interface in transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
The owner-supplied tokenAddress selects which external contract is called from the token contract.
